dataset.split: group holdout by desk_id; CV folds grouped by desk_id
dataset.na_note: overnight_frac MAR; primary path uses complete-case drop_nulls because na_action=omit mismatches residual length vs full data in interaction_screen/pair_candidates/tune

symptoms_vs_causes.finding: count response with mean<<variance on train (skewed / overdispersed)
symptoms_vs_causes.reading: Exception counts are non-negative integers with a long right tail. Start Poisson mean model; switch to NBinomial if family risk clears two-SE vs Poisson. Hetero LSS is a later nomination.
symptoms_vs_causes.would_count_against: Poisson CV risk competitive with NBinomial after structure terms.

symptoms_vs_causes.finding: complexity / overnight / legacy / vendors / staffing are ops drivers
symptoms_vs_causes.reading: More complex books, overnight settlement share, legacy stacks, and more vendors should raise exceptions; higher staff_per_bn should lower them. Treat aum_bn_proxy and complexity_z as collinear red herrings — keep one of each sibling pair.
symptoms_vs_causes.would_count_against: Proxy siblings clear two-SE after the primary is in the model.

symptoms_vs_causes.finding: panel dependence by desk_id; MAR on overnight_frac
symptoms_vs_causes.reading: Grouped folds by desk_id. na_action=omit so MAR overnight rows do not crash fits; do not impute inside the sealed challenge.
symptoms_vs_causes.would_count_against: Ignoring groups improves apparent CV but collapses on desk holdout.

symptoms_vs_causes.reading: Expect complexity×overnight or legacy×vendors style effects that are not pure products. Use interaction_screen + pair_candidates + tree_candidate; measure with two-SE compare.
symptoms_vs_causes.would_count_against: Nominated pairs fail two-SE against additive baseline.
